page.notes: Several Greek words are doubtful at the print's small size: the day names in XXVIII and XXIX, "Ἰσταμένου" in I, and the word after "Κυεία" in IX, XVIII and XXVIII. The Greek accents are uncertain throughout, so they are copied only where visible. Right-hand ends of some lines are unclear. Left-margin notes are fragmentary; the readings "[?]ησία I." and "[?]κλησια II." are doubtful at their starts, and "ἐκκλ. III." is read from a damaged line. Greek accents and the first letters of some entries (Εβδόμη, Κυρία, Γιγνομένη) are read from a small, worn print and may be imperfect. The catchword "ELAPHE-" is printed at the lower right, probably beginning "ἘΛΑΦΗΒΟΛΙΩΝΟΣ".
